name: Love, Death & Robots
description: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

videos.title: SONNIE'S EDGE
videos.overview: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

videos.title: THREE ROBOTS
videos.overview: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

videos.title: THE WITNESS
videos.overview: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

videos.title: SUITS
videos.overview: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

videos.title: SUCKER OF SOULS
videos.overview: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

videos.title: WHEN THE YOGURT TOOK OVER
videos.overview: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

videos.title: BEYOND THE AQUILA RIFT
videos.overview: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

videos.title: GOOD HUNTING
videos.overview: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

videos.title: THE DUMP
videos.overview: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

videos.title: SHAPE-SHIFTERS
videos.overview: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

videos.title: HELPING HAND
videos.overview: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

videos.title: FISH NIGHT
videos.overview: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

videos.title: LUCKY 13
videos.overview: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

videos.title: ZIMA BLUE
videos.overview: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

videos.title: BLINDSPOT
videos.overview: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

videos.title: ICE AGE
videos.overview: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

videos.title: ALTERNATE HISTORIES
videos.overview: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

videos.title: THE SECRET WAR
videos.overview: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

videos.title: Automated Customer Service
videos.overview: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

videos.title: Ice
videos.overview: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

videos.title: Pop Squad
videos.overview: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

videos.title: Snow in the Desert
videos.overview: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

videos.title: The Tall Grass
videos.overview: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

videos.title: All Through the House
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

videos.title: Life Hutch
videos.overview: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

videos.title: The Drowned Giant
videos.overview: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

videos.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
videos.overview: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

videos.title: Bad Travelling
videos.overview: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

videos.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
videos.overview: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

videos.title: Night of the Mini Dead
videos.overview: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

videos.title: Kill Team Kill
videos.overview: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

videos.title: Swarm
videos.overview: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

videos.title: Mason's Rats
videos.overview: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

videos.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
videos.overview: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

videos.title: Jibaro
videos.overview: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

videos.title: Can't Stop
videos.overview: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

videos.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
videos.overview: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

videos.title: Spider Rose
videos.overview: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

videos.title: 400 Boys
videos.overview: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

videos.title: The Other Large Thing
videos.overview: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

videos.title: Golgotha
videos.overview: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

videos.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
videos.overview: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

videos.title: How Zeke Got Religion
videos.overview: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

videos.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
videos.overview: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

videos.title: For He Can Creep
videos.overview: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

awards: Won 17 Primetime Emmys. 35 wins & 28 nominations total
